segments.text: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
(Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
He left Judæa, and departed again into Galilee.
And he must needs go through Samaria.
Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
Now Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Give me to drink.
(For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)

segments.speaker: Samaritan Woman
segments.text: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him,
How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: which am a woman of Samaria?
for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
Jesus answered and said unto her,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

segments.speaker: Samaritan Woman
segments.text: The woman saith unto him,
Sir,

segments.speaker: The woman
segments.text: thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?

segments.speaker: Samaritan Woman
segments.text: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
Jesus answered and said unto her,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
The woman saith unto him,

segments.speaker: The woman
segments.text: Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
Jesus saith unto her,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

segments.speaker: Samaritan Woman
segments.text: The woman answered and said,
I have no husband. Jesus said unto her,

segments.speaker: The woman
segments.text: Thou hast well said, I have no husband:

segments.speaker: The woman
segments.text: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.

segments.speaker: Samaritan Woman
segments.text: The woman saith unto him,
Sir,

segments.speaker: The woman
segments.text: I perceive that thou art a prophet.

segments.speaker: Samaritan Woman
segments.text: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Jesus saith unto her,
Woman, believe me,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
The woman saith unto him,

segments.speaker: The woman
segments.text: I know that Messias cometh,
which is called Christ:

segments.speaker: The woman
segments.text: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
Jesus saith unto her,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I that speak unto thee am he.
¶ And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,

segments.speaker: Samaritan Woman
segments.text: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
¶ In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying,

segments.speaker: Disciples
segments.text: Master, eat.
But he said unto them,

segments.speaker: Meanwhile the disciples
segments.text: I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
Therefore said the disciples one to another,

segments.speaker: The disciples
segments.text: Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
Jesus saith unto them,

segments.speaker: The disciples
segments.text: My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.

segments.speaker: The disciples
segments.text: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

segments.speaker: The disciples
segments.text: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.

segments.speaker: The disciples
segments.text: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

segments.speaker: The disciples
segments.text: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
¶ And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
And many more believed because of his own word;
And said unto the woman,

segments.speaker: The disciples
segments.text: Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
¶ Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilæans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judæa into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
Then said Jesus unto him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.

segments.speaker: Nobleman
segments.text: The nobleman saith unto him,
Sir,

segments.speaker: The official
segments.text: come down ere my child die.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Jesus saith unto him,
Go thy way;

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: thy son liveth.
And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him,

segments.speaker: the Father
segments.text: Thy son liveth:
and himself believed, and his whole house.
This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judæa into Galilee.
